summary: The analyst examines the severe market downturn affecting major indices, cryptocurrencies, and individual stocks like Nvidia following heavy losses. He reviews weekly and monthly charts of Bitcoin and the S&P 500, noting that all major sectors sit below their 200 EMA. Anticipating potential relief bounces, he emphasizes that lower highs and deeper retracements remain the primary expectation across multi-year timeframes. The U.S. dollar emerges as one of the few safe havens while global equities face broad selling pressure.
digest_it: L'autore analizza la forte correzione dei mercati e delle criptovalute, prevedendo possibili rimbalzi tecnici seguiti da ulteriori ribassi. Sottolinea che quasi tutti i settori si trovano sotto la media mobile a 200 periodi e che il dollaro resta l'unico vero rifugio sicuro.
tone_evidence: He consistently refers to the current market condition as a massacre and expects lower highs on monthly charts.

key_points.point: Bitcoin touched 55,000 dollars before recovering towards 61,400 dollars.
Nvidia experienced a fourteen percent drop during the sell-off.
The U.S. dollar index climbed to 103.840 as a safe-haven asset.
Bitcoin remains far below its 200 EMA located at 77,097 dollars.

moments.topic: Bitcoin monthly and weekly chart analysis
moments.claim: Bitcoin has broken below previous lows and is trading far below its 200 EMA.
moments.details: The asset dropped to 55,000 dollars, breaking the previous low from July, before bouncing back above 60,000 dollars. The author expects a recovery towards 70,000 to 75,000 dollars to avoid a bearish weekly flag, but warns that lower highs on monthly timeframes are probable.
moments.surprise: Bitcoin remains far below its 200 EMA at 77,097 dollars.
moments.scenario: Rebound to 70,000-75,000 dollars first, then determine if a larger bearish continuation occurs.
moments.conclusion: A recovery to at least 70,000 dollars is needed early next year to invalidate a larger weekly and monthly bear flag.

moments.claim: The S&P 500 and its equal-weight counterpart show significant retracements from their highs.
moments.details: The equal-weight S&P 500 ETF (RSP) posted seven consecutive red weeks, a rare occurrence seen previously only in 2002 and 2022. The author highlights that many sectors remain weak despite minor relief bounces.
moments.surprise: RSP posted seven consecutive red weeks, matching historic bear market patterns.
moments.scenario: Retrace above Fibonacci 0.38 and 0.5 levels to confirm a local bottom before further range-bound action.
moments.conclusion: Broad market indices need to reclaim key Fibonacci retracement levels to avoid deeper downside movement.

moments.claim: The Nasdaq 100 faces heavy retracement from its highs with limited safe havens available.
moments.details: The author examines the Nasdaq 100 chart, emphasizing that a return above the 0.38 and 0.5 Fibonacci levels is required to signal a meaningful recovery. With gold, equities, and cryptocurrencies all declining, the U.S. dollar index at 103.840 remains one of the few safe-haven assets.
moments.surprise: Almost all asset classes are down simultaneously, leaving cash as the primary safe haven.
moments.scenario: Bounce to test resistance zones around 28,000 before establishing a lower high range.
moments.conclusion: Without a surprise tech sector reversal led by companies like Nvidia, broad market recovery will remain sluggish.

predictions: Bitcoin to recover towards 70,000 to 75,000 dollars between January and February
S&P 500 and Nasdaq to test Fibonacci retracement levels before forming lower highs
curiosities: The equal-weight S&P 500 recorded seven consecutive red weeks, a pattern seen only in 2002 and 2022.
title: Il Mercato Che Ci Ha Distrutto i Portafogli
